issue_request: FHIR-22778 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CQI technical correction asking to remove duplicate ValueSet bullets from the R4 Measure Report Type CodeSystem page after the 'This Code system is used in the following value sets' heading; Jira records resolution 'Will fix' and Applied for Version R5.
initial_application: No FHIR-22778-keyed commit was found. The Jira reporter confirmed the R5 ballot page was fixed, and the R5 ballot output lists only the single MeasureReportType ValueSet under the CodeSystem usage heading. Git history shows the R5 source refactor commit 33b409a4b6 introduced separate Measure Report Type CodeSystem and ValueSet XML source files with a single all-codes relationship.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes MeasureReport, so the current source/measurereport terminology files are in build scope. Current source has one CodeSystem.valueSet, one all-codes MeasureReportType ValueSet include, one MeasureReport.type binding to that ValueSet, and the later FHIR-33004 MeasureReportEvaluationType ValueSet plus two operation bindings. The current build.fhir.org page repeats both ValueSet bullets, but those repeated entries correspond to valid source references and bindings and the duplicate-list aggregation text is not source-owned in this checkout.
reconciliation: No FHIR source file was changed. Removing valid CodeSystem, ValueSet, StructureDefinition, or OperationDefinition references would harm the current specification; remaining rendered-page de-duplication belongs in the publisher/site generator path, so the combined branch receives an empty external-repo audit commit.
